metadata.question: Does the surface water extent in Etosha Pan decrease from mid-January, 2020 to around late August, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Etosha Pan, Namibia (approximately -19.0°S, 15.8°E) - Dates: Mid-January 2020 (~Jan 15) vs Late August 2020 (~Aug 25) - Collection: JRC Global Surface Water or Sentinel-1/2 for water detection - Best approach: Use Sentinel-2 with water indices (NDWI/MNDWI) or Sentinel-1 for water mapping 2. Masking strategy: - Yes, mask clouds for optical data (Sentinel-2) - Calculate water extent using MNDWI or NDWI threshold - Compare total water pixels between the two periods 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Water extent is 0 (legitimate decrease to dry) - C1: No images found in collection - C2: All pixels masked (heavy clouds, no valid data) - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - A: Water extent decreased - B: Water extent stayed same or increased ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Etosha Pan geometry and time periods const etosha = ee.Geometry.Point([15.8, -19.0]).buffer(25000); // 25km radius const date1Start = '2020-01-10'; const date1End = '2020-01-20'; const date2Start = '2020-08-20'; const date2End = '2020-08-30'; // 2. Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // 3. Water detection function using MNDWI function addWater(image) { const mndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('water'); const waterMask = mndwi.gt(0.1); // Threshold for water return image.addBands(waterMask); } // 4. Get Sentinel-2 data for period 1 (mid-January) let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(etosha) .filterDate(date1Start, date1End) .map(maskS2clouds); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Period 1 (Jan 2020): ${size1} images`); if (size1 === 0) { console.log('No images for January 2020'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Get Sentinel-2 data for period 2 (late August) let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(etosha) .filterDate(date2Start, date2End) .map(maskS2clouds); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Period 2 (Aug 2020): ${size2} images`); if (size2 === 0) { console.log('No images for August 2020'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 6. Calculate water extent for both periods const img1 = col1.median().clip(etosha); const img2 = col2.median().clip(etosha); const water1 = addWater(img1).select('water'); const water2 = addWater(img2).select('water'); // 7. Count valid pixels const count1 = water1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: etosha, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('water').getInfo(); const count2 = water2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: etosha, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('water').getInfo(); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log(`Valid pixels - Jan: ${count1}, Aug: ${count2}`); console.log('C2'); return; } // 8. Calculate water area (sum of water pixels) const waterArea1 = water1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: etosha, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('water').getInfo(); const waterArea2 = water2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: etosha, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('water').getInfo(); // 9. Validation if (waterArea1 === null || waterArea2 === null) { console.log('Calculation failed'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Jan 2020 water pixels: ${Math.round(waterArea1)} (${count1} valid)`); console.log(`Aug 2020 water pixels: ${Math.round(waterArea2)} (${count2} valid)`); console.log(`Change: ${Math.round(waterArea2 - waterArea1)} pixels`); // 10. Final answer if (waterArea2 < waterArea1) { console.log('Water extent decreased from January to August 2020'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Water extent did not decrease'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
